name: Doomlings
description: Play traits to evolve the funniest creature before 3 catastrophes end the world. Most points when it ends wins.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** posted by Doomlings on its [How to Play page](https://www.doomlings.com/how). This is the current base game rulebook, matching the 3rd edition cards.
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages. Icons are described in words, so check the page image for those. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
This covers the base game. Expansions add their own traits and ages.
